response.overview: Cymbeline is queen of ancient Britain. When her daughter, Innogen, secretly marries against her mother's will, her wife Posthumus is banished to Rome. In exile, Posthumus places a bet on Innogen's innocence, a gamble they will soon regret. As Rome readies for war, can Innogen bridge her two worlds to bring peace and reconciliation? Filmed live at the candlelit Sam Wanamaker Playhouse.
response.tagline: Matriarchy, betrayal, and reconciliation under candlelit skies.
response.title: Cymbeline
